reason: B is the better proposal because it gives a clearer annealed baseline and, unlike A, recognizes that cold-work dislocations should dynamically recover and soften near 1250 °C rather than remain effective creep barriers. Both remain confounded and speculative because annealing changes more than dislocation density and a nominally single-phase alloy lacks a clearly established source of differential thermal expansion, but A also has an inconsistent temperature boundary and a less credible high-temperature mechanism.
